policy.notes: User-requested Unified Watch sends strict PRE-BUY and FINAL BUY only. PRE-BUY is one warning per opportunity episode; a second PRE-BUY or a late/high FINAL BUY requires a fresh post-alert reset + reclaim. Reset credentials expire after 1h and price drift above 8% from PRE-BUY is treated as chase risk. Generic near-buy/research/watch notifications remain silent. Does not weaken veteran REAL_ALERT policy.

truth_contract.source: Unified Watch exact-pair state + current intelligence report; fresh exact-state + close-watch-intelligence fallback on publication lag
